title: Signed-coordinate symbol encoding
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, and let $\mathrm{Ans}$ assign a Boolean value to each selector and pair of natural numbers. For an optional tape position $\tau$, a natural number $t$, and an integer $d$, define the encoded symbol value using time $t$, address $|d|$, and sign equal to true exactly when $d<0$.
hypotheses_covered: answer function on selectors and pairs of natural numbers
